name: The Canyons at Cimarron
summary: The Canyons at Cimarron is an open-air lifestyle center serving as the heart of Northwest El Paso's Cimarron community. This walkable, mixed-use destination features refined rustic elegance with integrated bike paths, outdoor seating areas, and a blend of shopping, dining, services, and office space designed to meet the needs of this growing 900-acre master-planned development.
demographics: The Canyons at Cimarron serves the growing Northwest El Paso Cimarron community, which consists of 2,236 homes and 500 apartment units across 900 acres. The primary trade area attracts middle to upper-middle income families and young professionals who value walkability and outdoor amenities. Visitors typically seek convenient shopping, dining, and services within a mixed-use environment that integrates with the community's extensive bike and walking trail system. The demographic profile skews toward families with children, given the 25 acres of parks and designated play areas, as well as active adults who appreciate the open-air, casual lifestyle format.
description: The Canyons at Cimarron is the heart of Northwest El Paso's thriving Cimarron community, serving as the premier gathering place for shopping, dining, and services in this rapidly growing 900-acre master-planned development. This open-air lifestyle center features refined rustic elegance that pays homage to the rugged beauty of the Southwest, creating an inviting atmosphere with shaded outdoor seating areas, lush landscaping, and a designated play area for families. The walkable, casual environment seamlessly integrates with Cimarron's seven miles of bike and walking trails, making it easily accessible to the community's 2,236 homes and 500 apartment units. Developed by EP Riverbend Development, the center is designed to be more than just a shopping destination—it's a mixed-use environment that promotes personal interaction and community pride, offering retail, dining, services, and office space all in one location. With its focus on creating unprecedented retail and service opportunities for Northwest El Paso, The Canyons at Cimarron represents where convenience, style, and community converge in a beautiful Southwestern setting.
